Net Income (Includes Extraordinary Items) also increased dramatically, jumping from 116.804 to 570.714. This is an exceptional increase.  The EPS (Earnings Per Share) metrics (Diluted and Basic) also improved, confirming stronger profitability.

**Overall Assessment:**

The company has shown impressive growth in revenue, profitability, and overall asset base.  The increase in total liabilities is manageable given the larger growth in equity and assets.  The considerable increase in net income and EPS indicates a strong financial performance and positive outlook.
